Introduction
This document outlines the 
testing procedure P1, which must performed on an annually bases as indicted by 
Y1 in the title block .
The first draft initiated 
by eng. 
Mohamed Abu Elkheir, 
reviewed by eng. Aly Abd Elglil Abd Elqader, 
tested by eng. 
Mohamed Younes Mahmoud at 06 Jan 2005, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. 
Abdel Menem Alemam, accepted by general director eng. Fawzy Sobhy Esmaile, and 
approved by eng. 
Mohamed Hamouda Elsarage 
Head Sector of 
Damietta CCPS.
This document is certified by eng. Samir 
 Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant; 
 Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Soliman;
 EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
Components
The historical data reporter (HDR20) 
consists of:
MSP card, processor for printer, part # (772B388G52).
MSL card, controller card, part # (7381A08G01).
MSE card, memory card, part # (7381A83G02).
MHC card, data high way controller card, part # (7381A93G01).
MMI power supply, input: 220VAC, output: 12VDC ,+5VDC , part # (4D33613G02).
Disk controller card, part # (405A689G04).
Magnetic tape controller card , part # (772B387G02).
6 cooling fan, 230 VAC, 14 WATT, part # (2450D25G03).
80MB hard disk, MAXFORT XT-1085, PART # (405A892H01).
This system can produce a detailed report of operation circumstances through a 
certain period of time.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear appropriate 
 personal protective safety equipment as safety shoes
 and helmet
Tools and Equipment
Screw 
 driver , nut driver , blower.
Spray video 
 cleaner.
Ground 
 strap.
Card 
 extractor.
Digital 
 voltmeter (DVM) .
Work to be Carried Out
Check the back up software for the cabinet.
Check the cabinet status by using (system 
 status display) diagram.
Check the operation of net work card function 
 (data highway controller card (MHC card) by using (system highway errors) 
 diagram.
Clean all cabinet cards from dust by blower.
Check the operation of cabinet cooling fan.
Check the MMI power supply of cabinet ( 12V 
 DC , 5V DC) .
Check the 
 trend function by making any trend on the operator station.
Check the free space on hard disk by using (HDR disk control) diagram on 
 the operator station.
